title: Write the behaviour-run rule: only for real rule changes
goal: The written rule says behaviour checks run only for real rule changes, never for wording, typo, link or layout fixes, and the PR says which
acceptance: AGENTS.md or the behaviour-checks page states the rule once, with its owner page; the PR template or pull-requests page asks the PR to say "rule change" or "wording only"

this is a governing-rule change: it lands with the F-020 consolidation of the same pages, one change keeping every requirement (rule-review "Periodic rule consolidation"), and is not written unattended before then
check:rules passes; the rule appears in one place and the others link to it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
